notes: Built from ep006.ts lines: only tags and CAPITALS added; words identical to say.
persona: You are an energetic, charismatic science YouTuber narrating a vertical short video. Sound like a real human influencer talking to a friend: conversational, expressive, with natural breaths and a smile in the voice. Change your speed, pitch, emphasis and rhythm with what is happening: an excited hook, tension that builds as the numbers climb (a little faster and higher each time), a punchy pause right before every big reveal, quiet awe at the climax, a playful twist, and a warm, friendly call to action. Words in CAPITALS get extra emphasis. Each line starts with a direction in parentheses: follow it, but never read the directions or the bracketed tags aloud.

lines.style: excited and fast, big smile, stress EVERY HUMAN
lines.tagged: What if EVERY HUMAN on Earth jumped at the same moment?

lines.style: relaxed and friendly, then quietly surprised at the second sentence
lines.tagged: Start with just you. You jump up, and the Earth REALLY does move down.

lines.style: building, a little faster and higher each time
lines.tagged: Now fill a stadium. Fill all of JAKARTA. Fill all of INDONESIA.

lines.style: big and proud, slow on the number
lines.tagged: Now EVERYONE alive. Eight point two BILLION people.

lines.style: stopping short, a playful catch, then explaining quickly
lines.tagged: But WAIT. People on opposite sides push in OPPOSITE directions, so a lot of it cancels out.

lines.style: sly and conspiratorial, enjoying the cheat
lines.tagged: So let's CHEAT. Pack all of us into ONE spot, all pushing the same way.

lines.style: a real countdown, slow and tense, shouting the last word
floating, then leaning in, teasing, a real question to the viewer
lines.tagged: We all rise half a meter. How far does the Earth drop? Take a GUESS.

lines.style: playful, shaking your head, each one smaller and quieter
lines.tagged: Not a centimeter. Not the width of a hair. Not even a VIRUS.

lines.style: quiet awe, slow and clear, then amazed
lines.tagged: Smaller than a single ATOM. Over two thousand times smaller.

lines.style: calm, explaining, a smile in the voice
lines.tagged: Because the Earth outweighs all of us almost TWELVE TRILLION to one.
And it doesn't even LAST. We land, and our landing pushes the Earth straight back.

lines.style: amused and matter of fact, landing on ZERO
lines.tagged: Right back where it started. Everyone alive, and the final score is ZERO.

lines.style: warm and delighted, a little secret for the viewer
lines.tagged: But every jump you've EVER made really did move the planet. Just not for long.
What should we TRY next? The best comment becomes the next video.
